summary: Clearwater National Forest lookout site; the present tower dates to 1954 (register and firelookout.com give an L-4 cab, Idaho Fire Lookouts a flat cab), sources disagree on earlier dates and height, and it is manned in fire season.

facts.design: L-4 cab per the register and firelookout.com; Idaho Fire Lookouts gives a flat cab

access.note: Staffed lookout that Idaho Fire Lookouts describes as drive-up. No public entry rules found in the sources.

visit.trail_note: Drive-up staffed lookout. Ask the Clearwater National Forest about current access before visiting.

events.note: Roofed platform on the site, per the register. The other two sources start at 1921.
Cupola cabin, per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts. The register dates its D-6 cupola cabin to 1923.
D-6 cupola cabin, per the register.
50-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab.
Idaho Fire Lookouts lists a known staff member for 1948. This predates the 1954 tower.
Present tower. The register and firelookout.com give an L-4 cab; Idaho Fire Lookouts gives a flat cab. Heights given as 54 ft (register), 53 ft (firelookout.com) and 41 ft (Idaho Fire Lookouts).
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register, April 6, 2009.
Idaho Fire Lookouts post dated August 9, 2021 says the tower is manned during fire season.

evidence.supports: site on the Idaho/Clearwater County line

evidence.quote: Developed in 1921 with a cupola cabin

evidence.supports: L-4 on a 50-foot pole tower in 1934
evidence.quote: an L-4 on a 50’ pole tower (1934)

evidence.supports: 50-foot pole tower and L-4 cab replaced earlier structure in 1934
evidence.quote: replaced with a 50' pole tower and L-4 cab

evidence.supports: register gives an L-4 cab on the 1954 tower
evidence.quote: a 14’x14’ L-4 cab with catwalk on a 54’ tower built in 1954
the present 53' treated timber tower with L-4 cab was built in 1954

evidence.supports: Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 41-foot flat cab tower built 1954
evidence.quote: 41′ TT Flat cab tower was built.
This tower is currently manned during fire season.

evidence.supports: still in service on the Clearwater National Forest
evidence.quote: Still in service on the Clearwater National Forest

corrections.why: 15.2 m (50 ft) matches the 1934 pole tower that the present tower replaced. The 1954 tower is 54 ft per the register (53 ft per firelookout.com).

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives a roofed platform in 1919. firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give a cupola cabin in 1921. The story reports both.
The register says 54 ft, firelookout.com says 53 ft and Idaho Fire Lookouts says 41 ft. The record uses the register's 54 ft (16.5 m).
The register and firelookout.com give the present tower an L-4 cab. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives a flat cab. The story reports both.
firelookout.com says staffed every summer (undated). Idaho Fire Lookouts says manned during fire season (post dated 2021). The register says still in service.

notes_for_editor: The Forest Service page (fs.fed.us, Nez Perce-Clearwater) failed to resolve, so the agency fact rests on the register alone. Height and first-structure dates conflict across sources. The 1948 known staff entry predates the 1954 tower. The register and firelookout.com give an L-4 cab for the 1954 tower; Idaho Fire Lookouts gives a flat cab. No current public access rules were found. Keeping Watch (UIdaho) gives only a coordinate and a link, so it is not cited.
